final: SELECT AVG(avg_bandusagepct) AS avg_group_bandusagepct, AVG(telescope_count) AS avg_group_telescope_count FROM (SELECT AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandusagepct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes AS t JOIN observatories AS o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.pointaccarc > 4.86 GROUP BY o.observstation, o.weathprofile)
